g.text: Three Korean earthquakes: the same spectra, three estimators
10.1 s multitaper, original site selections and path corrections; Kim & Kim (1983) source-depth velocity, density 2800 kg/m³, C=9.05.
Integral and direct Brune curves use their own estimated corners. They are diagnostic alternatives; the adopted magnitudes are unchanged.
